open_questions_for_vendor: Please confirm Inworld's full legal entity name, legal form and state of incorporation (we have 'Theai, Inc. dba Inworld AI' from your privacy notice) and the registered address to be used for GDPR purposes (we have 1975 W El Camino Real #300, Mountain View, CA 94040 from your privacy notice).
Has Theai, Inc. designated a representative in the Union under Article 27 GDPR? If yes, please provide the representative's name and full address; if no, please confirm in writing.

Has Inworld formally designated a Data Protection Officer? If yes, please provide the DPO's name and telephone number and/or email; if no, please confirm that privacy@inworld.ai is the authoritative contact for data-protection requests from SAP/Tavus.

Which TLS version is enforced (minimum and preferred) for the Inworld API and streaming endpoints that carry text inputs and generated speech audio in transit? Your security page says 'TLS' without a version.

Which AES key length (128/192/256) is used for customer data at rest, and does the same standard cover backups and archived media? Your security page says 'AES' without a key length and does not document backup encryption separately.
Who generates and manages the encryption keys for customer data at rest — Inworld-managed keys (customer-specific or shared), or is a customer-managed key (CMEK/BYOK) option available?
Can Inworld anonymize and/or pseudonymize customer personal data on the customer's instruction (beyond the workspace-level Zero Data Retention mode documented for TTS)?

Does Inworld's hosted API offer an EU region — i.e., processing and storage of customer data within the EU — as opposed to the on-premise/self-managed-VPC options on your website? If yes, which cloud regions?

Please provide your current SOC 2 Type II report (via trust.inworld.ai or directly to Tavus) so it can be placed on file as audit evidence for row 1.4.2, and confirm in writing which other certifications you actually hold — third-party profiles claim ISO 27001, FedRAMP, CSA STAR Level 1, PCI and HIPAA for Inworld, but we could only confirm SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA and GDPR claims from your own pages.
